skills.name: Demonic Slash (鬼斩/鬼斬り)
skills.line: Humans and spirits never co-existed in peace!
skills.description: Onikiri randomly draws one blade from Higekiri, Tomokiri and Shishinko to attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 80% of his ATK and activate its corresponding effect. ;Higekiri (髭切) :Gains a 20% Double Team chance for 1 turn. ;Tomokiri (友切) :Damage taken is reduced by 50%, removed after triggering 3 times. ;Shishinoko (獅子の子) :After Onmyoji defeats a non-summoned entity target, Demonic Slash strikes the enemy with the lowest HP percentage, then this blade effect disappears.

skills.name: Demonic Blade: Rajomon (鬼刃·罗城门/鬼の刃・羅城門)
skills.line: I am Onikiri, the blade that demons fear!
skills.description:
After attacking, Onikiri inflicts a follow-up attack on the target if their is below 85%, dealing damage equal to 125% of his ATK. Then inflicts another follow-up attack on all enemies if the target's HP is below 65%, dealing damage equal to 125% of his ATK.
Follow-up attacks ignore shields, the damage cannot be shared and do not trigger passives or soul effects. ; : ;Shield : :Can absorb a certain amount of damage, can crit, can stack with other shields created from different sources, without any specifications it can be dispelled or removed.

upgrades.text: At the start of battle, gain the effect of 1 random blade.
At the start of battle, gain the effect of 2 random blades.
At the start of battle, gain the effect of 3 random blades.
Each activated blade effect increases ATK by 15%.

skills.name: Shadow Slash (鬼影闪/鬼瞬影)
skills.line: Hear my blades in perfect harmony!
skills.description: Onikiri draws all three blades to launch 3-strikes on an enemy, dealing damage equal to 80% of his ATK and activates the effects of all three blades. ;Higekiri (髭切) :Gains a 20% Double Team chance for 1 turn. ;Tomokiri (友切) :Damage taken is reduced by 50%, removed after triggering 3 times. ;Shishinoko (獅子の子) :After Onmyoji defeats a non-summoned entity target, Demonic Slash strikes the enemy with the lowest HP percentage, then this blade effect disappears.

bio.condition: With Onikiri win 30 times in against Ibaraki Douji.
